pages.text: $(l)Reactors: Fuel and Cooling$()$(li)For Extreme Reactors, aim for exactly 100% active cooling; too much cooling slows heating and reduces efficiency.
$(li)For Nuclearcraft scrubbers, ensure 4 blocks of air on all sides—build them outside Compact Machines, and break out first to place externally.

$(li)Fuel from the NuclearCraft production bee behaves like real fuel: one player's reactor melted within seconds of switching to it, so check the design first.$(li)For Eutectic NaK automation, use 4× more potassium than sodium by volume to avoid imbalances.

$(l)Fluid Handling and Processing$()$(li)Process Salt Water, not Brine: salt water gives 40 mB molten sodium per salt, brine only 4 mB.$(li)Sodium hydroxide must be melted (not fluid-infused) before entering the Eutectic NaK production line.

$(li)When filtering fluids with XNet, enable metadata/NBT filtering for compounds like NaF/KF, set speed to 5000 mB/t, and use one fluid per filter.$(li)The salt mixer requires 3 separate XNet channels if filtering all inputs (e.g., NaF, KF, molten salt).
$(li)Do not void fluid byproducts (e.g., oxygen, HF); store them in a black hole tank for later high-tier use like FLiBe production.
